name: Townhouse OAK Makati Manila Near PNR Pasay Evangelista formerly VIP Suites
detail: The cost performance is the best! The front staff were very kind. There were no amenities, but that wasn't a problem. There was a built-in hairdryer. They gave me towels when I asked. I had the four-person room all to myself. Personally, I had no issues at all. I would love to come back.

name: Savea Bay City Manila
detail: I am almost perfectly satisfied with the size of the room, cleanliness, amenities, and location. However, there is one point: the shower temperature is low every time, so I believe it would be even more comfortable if you could improve it to allow for a higher temperature.

name: Townhouse College Residences in University Belt, Metro Manila
detail: The location is incredibly convenient, making it easy to explore the area on foot. The room size and bathroom were comfortable and clean, contributing to a restful sleep. Staff were attentive and facilities well-maintained, enhancing the overall experience. This place offers excellent value for money and is highly recommended for anyone visiting the area.

name: Seda Bonifacio Global City Manila
detail: It had the atmosphere of a mid-range business hotel located in the safest district of Manila. The building and rooms weren't very new, but they were sufficiently clean. The water pressure and temperature in the shower were comfortable. If there was a drawback, it was that the towels felt old (they were clean and laundered, but their age was undeniable). The hustle and bustle of the city was uniquely Manila, yet the streets were beautifully maintained, and the shopping areas were abundant. Although this stay was for business, I think it would also be a lovely hotel to relax in for sightseeing. I found the hotel staff's genuine smiles and hospitality remarkable. The breakfast was satisfying, featuring local dishes like sweetened rice with adzuki beans, adding a touch of regional flavor that was enjoyable.
area: Bonifacio Global City (BGC) / Taguig,Manila - View on map

name: St Giles Makati – A St Giles Hotel, Manila
detail: When I come to Makati, I usually stay here, and I think the overall cost performance is really good. It's located on a main road, so you can hear quite a bit of car horns, but it has a pool, breakfast included, and there are various shops and malls nearby, which I think makes it very convenient.

name: City Garden GRAND Hotel
detail: Overall, it meets the passing mark. The room size and cleanliness are sufficient. The view is nice, and the staff's service was good. The pool has a good view and atmosphere, but it is uncomfortably cold due to strong winds after sunset, and it lacks space for swimming. It is good for cooling down. The bed was not well constructed and creaked at times. The breakfast felt ordinary in taste, quantity, and variety for its price. There wasn't anything that stood out as delicious. The location is very good, so depending on the price, I would generally like to use it again.

name: Savoy Hotel Manila near Airport NAIA Terminal 3 MNL
detail: I used this when I arrived in Manila for the first time on a late-night flight. It's about a 15-minute walk from the airport. However, there are no traffic signals or crosswalks, so you need to be careful of cars when crossing the major road. It may be a bit of a detour, but I think it's safer to use the airport-connected passage RUNWAY MANILA to cross the main road. I checked in around 3 AM, and the staff were kind and handled everything smoothly. The room had everything I needed. It was clean and comfortable to sleep in. I booked a room with an airport view, but since there are quite a few flights and there's a bypass right in front of me, there was quite a bit of traffic, and I found the noise a bit bothersome. If you want a quiet rest, it might be better to stay in a room without an airport view. The breakfast was served buffet-style and was very satisfying. I definitely recommend adding it when making a reservation. Once you leave the hotel, you can easily catch a jeepney on the main road. It's conveniently located for heading towards Baclaran (you can get off partway and walk to the church or market), making it a good place to start experiencing the Philippines. I would like to use it again when I go to Manila.

name: Hotel101 - Fort
detail: Everything is very convenient, priced appropriately, close to SM, convenience stores, and the bus station. There are staff to clean my room every day.
area: Bonifacio Global City (BGC) / Taguig,Manila - View on map

name: Kingsford Hotel Manila Bay
detail: This hotel is really good. The price is around 7,000 yen per room per night, so if two people stay, it’s just 3,500 yen per person, which is a great deal. It is more spacious and cleaner than a typical business hotel in Japan. Additionally, there is a buffet breakfast included at the restaurant. There is also a pool, sauna, and gym available. You can request a massage in your room. The water pressure in my shower was high. Towels, sheets, and garbage disposal won’t be changed unless you ask. If you ask the cleaning staff outside your room, they will change them immediately. It doesn't feel like a budget accommodation, but it’s not a luxury hotel either. There is luggage inspection at the entrance, and the elevator requires a room card to access the floors, which adds to the security. The in-room Wi-Fi is also fine (downloading 130 Mbps, uploading 100 Mbps). It is almost right in front of Okada Manila, so you can walk there in about 3 to 4 minutes for the casino. I plan to use it again when I come to Manila.

name: Hotel101 – Manila
detail: 1. The price is cheaper compared to similar categories. 2. The cost-performance ratio is very good. 3. The swimming pool is well maintained and clean. 4. They also do a good job with beach towel rentals. 5. The staff is friendly, and cleanliness is neat. 6. The breakfast is quite tasty. 7. Amenities were provided, so I used them comfortably. 8. The bathroom is clean, and the water pressure is strong. Overall, I am satisfied. 101 Hotel is great.
